bio: Gregory Hernandez is a Montreal mortgage broker with Orbis Mortgage Group, licensed as a broker since 2023 after working as a mortgage specialist for Canadian banks since 2008. He says he accesses over 40 lenders and covers pre-approval, zero-down, purchase, rental investment, refinance, auto-construction, land finance and commercial lending. The site is bilingual (English/French) and claims 1800+ projects and over $540 million financed.
tagline: We're the leaders in creating affordable mortgages that fit every budget.
